what: Table 1: how each curated product of the four protocols maps onto the curation model of §2.2 (docs/outline.md). Compiled by hand from the E1 notes and the protocols' own code and documentation.

columns.object: the curated object a depositor holds shares of
columns.allocation: who moves the deposits across markets
columns.collateral: who decides which collateral the deposits are lent against
columns.instruments: the curator's instruments and their constraints (caps, timelocks, queues)
columns.oracle: who chooses the oracle and when it can change
columns.fee: the fee depositors pay and who receives it
columns.exit: how a withdrawal is paid and what limits it

rows.allocation: Allocators, curator, owner: reallocation, supply and withdraw queues
rows.collateral: Market creator, fixed at creation; the curator enables markets by cap
rows.instruments: Cap per market, ≤ 30 markets; cap raises and removals timelocked (1 day to 2 weeks; V1.1 may start at 0); owner or guardian can revoke
rows.fee: Performance fee ≤ 50% of interest, set by the owner; governance fee switch ≤ 25% per market
rows.exit: Withdraw queue, each market up to its idle liquidity; reverts when short

sources.used_for: roles, caps, queues, 30 markets, timelock of at least 24 hours, fee up to 50%, withdrawals up to market liquidity
withdrawal reverts NotEnoughLiquidity when the withdraw queue is short; ConstantsLib: MIN_TIMELOCK 1 day, MAX_TIMELOCK 2 weeks, MAX_QUEUE_LENGTH 30, MAX_FEE 0.5e18
initial timelock 0 or 1 day to 2 weeks, later changes 1 day to 2 weeks
permissionless market creation; MAX_FEE 0.25e18 in src/libraries/ConstantsLib.sol
V1 roles and events observed (owner, curator, guardian, allocator; AccrueInterest fee shares)

rows.allocation: Allocators, through adapters (markets, V1 vaults); they set the liquidity adapter
rows.collateral: Market creator; the curator enables adapters and caps each collateral
rows.instruments: Absolute and relative caps per risk id (collateral, market, adapter); per-function timelocks, cap cuts immediate; sentinels de-risk
rows.fee: Performance ≤ 50% of interest and management ≤ 5% a year, set by the curator
rows.exit: Idle assets, then the liquidity adapter; in kind via forceDeallocate (penalty ≤ 2%)

sources.used_for: adapters, id caps, per-function timelocks, sentinels, fees, liquidity adapter, forceDeallocate and in-kind redemption
V2 roles (owner, curator, allocator, sentinel), adapter types, performance and management fee shares

rows.allocation: Allocators, curator, owner, across ERC-4626 strategies (Euler lending vaults)
rows.instruments: Cap per strategy, ≤ 30 strategies; cap raises and removals timelocked (0 or 1 day to 2 weeks); owner or guardian can revoke
rows.fee: Performance fee ≤ 50% of interest, set by the owner
rows.exit: Withdraw queue, each strategy up to its cash; reverts when short

sources.used_for: fork of MetaMorpho V1.1 over ERC-4626 strategies; roles, caps, timelock, 30 strategies, fee up to 50%
withdrawal reverts NotEnoughLiquidity when short; ConstantsLib: POST_INITIALIZATION_MIN_TIMELOCK 1 day, MAX_TIMELOCK 2 weeks, MAX_QUEUE_LENGTH 30, MAX_FEE 0.5e18
Earn roles observed (owner, curator, guardian, allocator); 2025 caps-and-queues design on every chain (docs/experiment-result.md §1.4)

rows.allocation: None: depositors supply the vault directly
rows.collateral: Governor: accepted collateral vaults and their LTVs
rows.instruments: Borrow and liquidation LTV per collateral (cuts can ramp), supply and borrow caps, rate model, hooks; no timelock
rows.fee: Interest fee set by the governor (10% to 100% without DAO approval); the Euler DAO takes ≤ half of it
rows.exit: Withdraw up to the vault's cash

sources.used_for: governed vs finalised vaults, setLTV with borrow and liquidation LTV, LTV ramping, supply and borrow caps, interest fee 10% to 100% guaranteed range, protocol fee share capped at 50%, oracle fixed at creation
EulerRouter can be reconfigured by its governor
governance events (GovSetLTV and other Gov*), initial governor from EVaultCreated; 75 of 889 Ethereum vaults renounced governance (docs/experiment-result.md §1.2)
an observed router reconfiguration on Plasma (USDe/USD adapter replaced by a fixed rate)

rows.allocation: Allocators, curator, owner: reallocation, supply and withdraw queues
rows.collateral: Silo deployer, fixed at creation; the curator enables silos by cap
rows.instruments: Cap per market, ≤ 30 markets; cap raises and additions timelocked (1 day to 2 weeks); guardian veto

rows.fee: Vault: performance ≤ 50% of interest, set by the owner; silo: deployer fee (DAO-set cap, 15% at launch) and DAO fee on interest
rows.exit: Withdraw queue, each silo up to its liquidity; reverts when short
